description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing patient profiles in a healthcare backend API. It includes CRUD operations with role-based access control (RBAC), mapping database documents to Patient models, and enforces permissions for each operation.

classes.name: Patient
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a patient profile.

classes.name: PatientCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new patient.

classes.name: PatientUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating patient details.

methods.name: Patient _patient_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB patient document to a Patient model.

methods.name: None _assert_patient_owner_or_admin( patient_doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Enforces RBAC by checking if the user is either an admin or the owner of the patient record.

methods.name: List[Patient] list_patients(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin", "doctor"])))
methods.description: Returns a list of all patients, accessible only to admin and doctor roles.

methods.name: Patient create_patient( payload: PatientCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Creates a new patient profile with RBAC restrictions.

methods.name: Patient get_patient( patient_id: str = Path(..., description="Patient document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Retrieves a patient profile by ID, with permission checks for admin, doctor, or owner.

methods.name: Patient update_patient( patient_id: str, payload: PatientUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Updates a patient profile; allowed for admin or the owner.

methods.name: None delete_patient( patient_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a patient profile; restricted to admin role.

ctags.name: _assert_patient_owner_or_admin
ctags.signature: ( patient_doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any] )

ctags.name: create_patient
ctags.signature: ( payload: PatientCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )

ctags.name: get_patient
ctags.signature: ( patient_id: str = Path(..., description="Patient document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )

ctags.name: update_patient
ctags.signature: ( patient_id: str, payload: PatientUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
